task_summary: Fetch PR and issue data from cli/cli for December 2024 using gh CLI, compute metrics, and output a structured report.json
decomposition_rationale: The task has two distinct data domains (PRs and issues) but they share the same data fetching mechanism and output format. I decompose into: (1) a foundational skill for fetching GitHub data via gh CLI subprocess calls, and (2) a skill for computing metrics and assembling the final report. This keeps data I/O separate from business logic.

skills.name: evo-gh-data-fetcher
skills.description: Fetches pull request and issue data from a GitHub repository using the gh CLI tool via Python subprocess. Handles JSON output parsing, pagination limits, date range filtering, and error handling.
skills.responsibility: Execute gh CLI commands to retrieve PR and issue data with proper flags (--search, --state, --json, --limit), parse JSON output, and return structured Python lists of dictionaries.
dr_sections: 1. The `gh` CLI Commands for Listing and Filtering
3. Date and Time Parsing in Python

skills.name: evo-gh-report-generator
skills.description: Computes community pulse metrics from raw PR and issue data and writes a structured report.json file. Calculates PR counts by state, average time-to-merge, top contributor, bug issue counts, and resolved bugs.
skills.responsibility: Process fetched PR/issue data to compute all required metrics (total/merged/closed PRs, avg merge days, top contributor, total issues, bug count, resolved bugs) and serialize results to /app/report.json.
dr_sections: 3. Date and Time Parsing in Python
